query:
SELECT
            id         AS "id!: Uuid",
            name       AS "name!",
            is_active  AS "is_active!",
            start_date AS "start_date!: NaiveDate",
            end_date   AS "end_date!: NaiveDate",
            created_at AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
        FROM menu
        WHERE is_active = TRUE
          AND start_date <= $1
          AND end_date   >= $1
        ORDER BY start_date DESC
        LIMIT 1
